BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Brian Mac Mahon is delighted to bring to the market this mixed-use premises located on a peaceful and family-friendly setting of Gort, Co. Galway, this well-equipped crèche offers a safe, stimulating, and nurturing environment for early childhood learning and development.

This purpose-built crèche provides ample space for parking and turn-around. There are 4 multi - function rooms, each thoughtfully designed to support class-based learning, play, and creativity for children of various age groups. There is an additional large outdoor play area split into 3 sections offering a safe and clean space for children to enjoy outdoor play. There is also a sleep room, changing room, kitchen, staff room, office there are three toilet facilities within the building, ensuring convenience, hygiene, and comfort for both children and staff. There are 2 sheds to the rear of the building for storage.

This crèche presents an ideal setting for childcare providers seeking a ready-to-use facility in a supportive community location.

Capacity: 30

Overhead the residential element provides a spacious 4-bedroom apartment with a private rear garden.

Gort is a busy market town, and a local market is held every Friday in the town square. It has all the amenities available including supermarkets, 4* hotel with full leisure centre restaurants, boutiques, pharmacies, Garda station, primary and secondary schools. Gort has excellent transport links with a regular bus service to Galway and Cork and is on a Limerick/Galway train route. It has easy access to the motorway making Galway, Limerick and Dublin within easy reach. It is only a 40-minute drive from Galway city and Shannon airport is 30 minutes away.
